title: Chest Preview
description: This mod allows you to see the content of a chest or other containers by just looking at them.
body:
# 👀 Chest Preview

Stop opening every chest blindly.

**Chest Preview** lets you instantly preview container contents just by looking at them — fast, smooth, and completely vanilla-friendly.

No more wasting time checking empty chests, barrels, or shulker boxes one by one. Simply look at a container and a clean animated preview appears on your screen showing everything inside.

Perfect for:
- Survival players
- Storage builders
- Technical players
- Multiplayer servers
- Loot hunters
- Streamers & YouTubers

---

# ✨ Features

## 📦 Instant Container Preview
Preview contents without opening:
- Chests
- Double Chests
- Barrels
- Shulker Boxes
- Hoppers
- Dispensers
- Furnaces
- Blast Furnaces
- Smokers

---

## 🎨 Beautiful Vanilla-Style UI
Designed to feel like an official Minecraft feature.

- Smooth fade animations
- Clean scaling effects
- Elegant compact layout
- Modern polished visuals
- Vanilla-friendly design

---

## 💎 Smart Item Rendering
See important details instantly:
- Stack counts
- Enchantment glint
- Hover tooltips
- Rare item highlighting

Rare items like:
- Diamonds
- Netherite
- Elytra
- Totems
- Ancient Debris
- Enchanted Gear

…receive subtle visual glow effects.

---

## ⚡ Smart Detection System
The preview only appears when:
- You are close enough
- You have direct line of sight
- The container is actually visible

This keeps the mod immersive and optimized.

---

## 🛠 Fully Configurable
Customize everything:
- Preview distance
- UI scale
- Animation toggle
- Blacklisted containers
- Rare item highlighting

---

## 🌐 Multiplayer Friendly
- Purely visual
- No item duplication
- Safe for servers
- Lightweight and optimized
- Minimal performance impact

---

# ❤️ Why You'll Love It

After using Chest Preview once, you won’t want to play without it anymore.

It makes storage management faster, looting smoother, and survival gameplay feel significantly more modern — while still keeping the classic Minecraft feel.

A tiny quality-of-life feature that changes everything.

---

# 🚀 Project
- Optimized for Fabric
- Stable and lightweight
- Survival friendly
- Clean modern codebase
